products.name: Apps Script & AppSheet Work-Transformation Governance — Commercial
products.short_description: Establish governance for Apps Script & AppSheet — approval patterns, data-access guardrails, environment/sharing standards, and a review model — so workflow redesign happens safely and to standard, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Let the business build workflows — safely and to standard

Google's Apps Script and AppSheet let teams automate and rebuild workflows fast — which becomes shadow IT and risk without governance. This solution establishes the work-transformation governance for Apps Script and AppSheet: approval patterns, security/data-access guardrails, environment and sharing standards, and a review model — so citizen and pro developers redesign workflows safely and to enterprise standard, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the automation governance model for Apps Script + AppSheet: where the risk is (data access, sharing, OAuth scopes) and how governance channels it.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Workspace admin controls for Apps Script/AppSheet, data-governance baseline, a review model, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to set the admin guardrails (app access/OAuth, AppSheet governance, sharing), define the approval/review pattern and environments, pilot, and expand.
  • 5 supporting scripts — Apps Script/AppSheet inventory discovery, guardrail conformance validation, an automation coverage/risk report, safe remediation, and a scope helper.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides plus Best Practices for safe citizen development and workflow redesign.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Business-led workflow automation that's fast and safe — Apps Script and AppSheet governed with guardrails, approvals, and standards — not shadow IT.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GWAUTO-Discovery.ps1 — inventory Apps Script projects and AppSheet apps and their governance exposure
    • GWAUTO-Remediation.ps1 — open owned, dated remediation actions for non-conformant automations
    • GWAUTO-Report.ps1 — report Apps Script/AppSheet automation coverage and governance risk
    • GWAUTO-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create the OU/group scope that the automation guardrails target
    • GWAUTO-Validation.ps1 — check Apps Script and AppSheet guardrail conformance against the gates

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
